```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('/home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/content/english/blog/alex-eala-pro-career-tracker.md').read_text()

# Extract H2H ### names and their H2H URLs
h2h = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'^### (.+)\n\n- \[WTA Profile\].*\n- \[Head to Head\]\((https://www\.wtatennis\.com/head-to-head/330332/\d+)\)', text, re.M):
    h2h[m.group(1).strip()] = m.group(2)
print('H2H blocks:', len(h2h))
for k,v in h2h.items():
    print(f'  {k}: {v}')

# Watch list
watch = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'^- \[([^\]]+)\]\((https://www\.wtatennis\.com/head-to-head/330332/\d+)\)', text, re.M):
    watch[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
print('Watch:', len(watch))

# Result lines in GS + Best Perf (before H2H section)
cut = text.split('## Matches Against Grand Slam Champions')[0]
# sections of interest
gs = cut.split('## Grand Slam Main Draw Results')[1].split('## Best Performances in WTA Tournaments')[0]
bp = cut.split('## Best Performances in WTA Tournaments')[1]

def extract_names(section):
    names = []
    # d./l. Name or Name/Name before score or w/o or |
    for m in re.finditer(r'\b[dl]\. ([^|]+?)(?: \| |$)', section):
        names.append(m.group(1).strip())
    return names

print('\n--- Grand Slam names ---')
for n in extract_names(gs):
    print(repr(n))
print('\n--- Best Perf names ---')
for n in extract_names(bp):
    print(repr(n))
PY
```
